system.description: Essence Training Package Spell List 14.1.1 - Arachnemancy. Spells to bond with a spider familiar, spin and control webs and web ropes, control and summon spiders, and mimic spider abilities such as climbing and poison.

The caster can attune himself to a normal spider to serve as his familiar. The caster must obtain the spider through normal means (can be no more than 10% of caster's own mass) and cast this spell on the creature once per day for 1 week (concentrating for 2 hours per day). The caster can then control the familiar and view the world through its senses by concentrating on it (though the familiar must be within 50' per level). If the creature is killed, the caster gets a -25 modification to all actions for 2 weeks. Any spell that affects 'familiars' will affect this spider.
Allows caster to move along the webs of giant spiders easily. Webs will not stick to the caster and he will be able to move freely through any 'web' spell.

Caster creates a web rope (from click, from throw, etc.) Each round, a 10' strand can be produced that will support 2000 lbs. One end will be 'projected' away from the caster and will stick to whatever it hits (the rest of the strand will not be sticky). On subsequent rounds, the length of strand may be extended by 10' per round (each 10' extension decreases the weight the strand can hold by 100 pounds). Alternatively, the caster can create new strands each round. At the end of the duration, the web ropes become brittle and snap easily.

Web strands shoot out of the caster's hand at one target. If the target fails an RR, the amount of his body covered in the web is equal to the percent of failure. For example, if a target fails his RR by 25, 25% of his body is covered in the web. The portion of the body covered must be determined by the GM. If a limb or limbs are covered, they cannot be used. Breaking the web requires a Very Hard maneuver (modified by the victim's Strength bonus).
The spell will cause any arachnid-type creature to believe the caster to be a good friend. This spell will also allow the caster to speak and understand the language of spiders.
Caster may move along (at half walking pace) any solid surface angled up to 90 degrees so long as he maintains at least three of his four limbs in contact with the surface.

Caster will summon a lesser spider that will obey his wishes when he concentrates. If such spiders are common to the area, then the spider will appear slowly over the course of 3 rounds. If such spiders are not common to the area, then the spider will appear slowly over the course of 10 rounds.
As Minor Web Rope, except the caster can produce two 10' strands per round or one 20' strand per round.
As Minor Web, except that the caster can hit two separate targets or two targets together or 'attach' one target to a non-mobile object (object gets no RR). The breaking maneuver is Extremely Hard.
Any poison inside the target must make an RR. If the RR fails, the poison is completely neutralized.
As Charm Spider, except that the target will obey one 'suggestion' per round.

Allows caster to either be a poisonous touch or a poisonous bite. If the caster chooses a poisonous touch, the caster's finger tips will begin to secrete a poisonous venom. If this poison touches any bare skin (other than the caster's), it will deliver a Muscle Poison (level determined by rolling a d10). If the caster chooses a poisonous bite, the next bite that delivers a critical hit (even a Tiny critical) will be accompanied by a Circulatory Poison (level determined by rolling 2d10). The spell ceases to function once it has delivered one poison from an attack.
As Lesser Spider Summons, except that a greater great spider is summoned.
As Greater Spider Shapechange, except caster takes the form (and has all of the abilities) of a lesser great spider.
As Major Web Rope, except the caster can produce a 30' strand each round.
As Major Web, except that up to one target for every two levels of the caster can be targeted or 'webbed' together or half of that number can be webbed to non-mobile objects.
Completely encases target in webbing. Breaking the cocoon requires an Absurd maneuver (with a special modification of -20; modified by Strength bonus).
As Spider Climb, except that only one limb need be in contact with the surface, and any angled surface, even ceilings, can be moved along at full movement rate.
As Lesser Spider Summons, except a major great spider is summoned.

Summons hundreds of normal-sized spiders (a mixture of poisonous and non-poisonous based upon what is common to the area) that swarm over a 10'R area. These spiders will stay together as a unit for 3d10 rounds (and can move into a new 10'R area each round; the caster has no control over this spell). Anyone in the area of effect must make d10 RRs versus a Reduction Poison each round. The GM can determine the level of the poison, each round or he can use a level of d10-5. After 3d10 rounds, the spiders will wander away.
Shapechange—As Lesser Spider Shapechange, except caster takes the form of a greater great spider.
As Spider Control, except all spiders in the radius can be controlled.
Caster can use one spell from this list each round. All spiders who see the caster will regard him as master and obey him.
